arxiv-2103-08906.title: On the finiteness of four-body central configurations
arxiv-2103-08906.creator: Xiang Yu, Shuqiang Zhu School of Mathematics, Southwestern University of Finance and Economics,Chengdu 611130, China
arxiv-2103-08906.description: Abstract The number of central configurations in the four body problem was proved to be finite, first by Hampton and Moeckel, then by Albouy and Kaloshin, when the masses are all positive. We prove that the four-body central configurations are finite for any four nonzero masses. 2020AMS Subject Classification : 70F10 70F15 37Nxx .

arxiv-2108-11275.title: Ontology-Enhanced Slot Filling
arxiv-2108-11275.creator: Yuhao Ding, Yik-Cheung Tam
arxiv-2108-11275.description: Abstract Slot filling is a fundamental task in dialog state tracking in task-oriented dialog systems. In multi-domain task-oriented dialog system, user utterances and system responses may mention multiple named entities and attributes values. A system needs to select those that are confirmed by the user and fill them into destined slots.

arxiv-2111-11479.title: Gradient estimate for solutions of second-order elliptic equations
arxiv-2111-11479.creator: Vladimir Maz’ya, Robert McOwen
arxiv-2111-11479.description: Abstract . We obtain a local estimate for the gradient of solutions to a second-order elliptic equation in divergence form with bounded measurable coefficients that are square-Dini continuous at the single point x = 0 x=0 . In particular, we treat the case of solutions that are not Lipschitz continuous at x = 0 x=0 .

arxiv-2202-08045.title: Learning to Generalize across Domains on Single Test Samples
arxiv-2202-08045.creator: Zehao Xiao, Xiantong Zhen, Ling Shao, Cees G. M. Snoek
arxiv-2202-08045.description: Abstract We strive to learn a model from a set of source domains that generalizes well to unseen target domains. The main challenge in such a domain generalization scenario is the unavailability of any target domain data during training, resulting in the learned model not being explicitly adapted to the unseen target domains.

arxiv-2205-07397.title: Topological Superconductivity in Sn/Si(111) driven by non-local Coulomb interactions
arxiv-2205-07397.creator: Mehdi Biderang, Mohammad-Hossein Zare, Jesko Sirker
arxiv-2205-07397.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Mehdi Biderang, Mohammad-Hossein Zare, Jesko Sirker. Superconductivity was recently observed in boron-doped ( 3 × 3 \sqrt{3}\times\sqrt{3} )Sn/Si(111). The material can be described by an extended Hubbard model on a triangular lattice. Here, we use the random-phase approximation to investigate the charge and spin fluctuations as well as the superconducting properties of the system with respect to filling and the relative strength of the extended versus the on-site Hubbard interactions.

arxiv-2307-06238.title: Astrometric Calibration and Performance of the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument Focal Plane
arxiv-2307-06238.creator: S. Kent, E. Neilsen, K. Honscheid, D. Rabinowitz, E. F. Schlafly, J. Guy, D. Schlegel, J. García-Bellido, T. S. Li, E. Sanchez, J. Silber, J. Aguilar, S. Ahlen, D. Brooks, T. Claybaugh, A. de la Macorra, P. Doel, D. J. Eisenstein, K. Fanning, A. Font-Ribera, J. E. Forero-Romero, S. Gontcho A Gontcho
arxiv-2307-06238.description: Abstract The Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument, consisting of 5020 robotic fiber positioners and associated systems on the Mayall telescope at Kitt Peak, Arizona, is carrying out a survey to measure the spectra of 40 million galaxies and quasars and produce the largest 3D map of the universe to date.

arxiv-2406-05383.title: A Discrete Exterior Calculus of Bundle-valued Forms
arxiv-2406-05383.creator: Theo Braune, Yiying Tong, François Gay-Balmaz, Mathieu Desbrun
arxiv-2406-05383.description: Abstract The discretization of Cartan’s exterior calculus of differential forms has been fruitful in a variety of theoretical and practical endeavors: from computational electromagnetics to the development of Finite-Element Exterior Calculus, the development of structure-preserving numerical tools satisfying exact discrete equivalents to Stokes’ theorem or the de Rham complex for the exterior derivative have found numerous applications in computational physics.

arxiv-2410-19527.title: Modelling the influence of streamwise flow field acceleration on the aerodynamic performance of an actuator disc
arxiv-2410-19527.creator: Clemens Paul Zengler 1 , Niels Troldborg, Mac Gaunaa
arxiv-2410-19527.description: Abstract Streamwise acceleration of the background flow field is one of various effects occurring when wind turbines operate under non-idealized conditions, such as in complex terrain or in dense wind farms. Thus, studying this effect is essential to improve understanding of aerodynamic performance in these cases.

They increase revenue for businesses while improving the consumer experience by recommending relevant products amidst huge product base. arxiv-2502-00891.title: Isoperimetric inequality for nearly spherical domains in the Bergman ball in ℂ n \mathbb{C}^{n}
arxiv-2502-00891.creator: David Kalaj
arxiv-2502-00891.description: Abstract . We prove a quantitative isoperimetric inequality for the nearly spherical subset of the Bergman ball in ℂ n \mathbb{C}^{n} . We prove the Fuglede theorem for such sets. This result is a counterpart of a similar result obtained for the hyperbolic unit ball and it makes the first result on the isoperimetric phenomenon in the Bergman ball.

arxiv-2508-19176.title: Graded Ehrhart theory and toric geometry
arxiv-2508-19176.creator: Ian Cavey
arxiv-2508-19176.description: Abstract We give two new constructions of the harmonic algebra of a lattice polytope P P , a bigraded algebra whose character is the q q -Ehrhart series of P P defined by Reiner and Rhoades [ 6 ] .

arxiv-2510-15993.title: Aligning Language Models with Investor and Market Behavior for Financial Recommendations Conference: 6th ACM International Conference on AI in Finance; November 15–18, 2025; Singapore, Singapore 6th ACM International Conference on AI in Finance (ICAIF ’25), November 15–18, 2025, Singapore, Singapore
arxiv-2510-15993.creator: Fernando Spadea, Oshani Seneviratne
arxiv-2510-15993.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Fernando Spadea, Oshani Seneviratne. Most financial recommendation systems often fail to account for key behavioral and regulatory factors, leading to advice that is misaligned with user preferences, difficult to interpret, or unlikely to be followed. We present FLARKO (Financial Language-model for Asset Recommendation with Knowledge-graph Optimization), a novel framework that integrates Large Language Models (LLMs), Knowledge Graphs (KGs), and Kahneman-Tversky Optimization (KTO) to generate asset recommendations that are both profitable and behaviorally aligned.

pmc-10633889.title: Efficient cyanide sensing using plasmonic Ag/Fe3O4 nanoparticles†
pmc-10633889.creator: Razieh Moosavi, Ramin Zibaseresht
pmc-10633889.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). In the line of our previous studies, we have reported a developed sensitive and selective probe for cyanide detection based on Ag/Fe3O4 nanoparticles (NPs) with an extremely low limit of detection at the level of ng per milliliter. Herein, we report the improvement of the easy-to-make magnetic silver nanoparticle-based sensor system for cyanide determination in an extended calibration range with higher selectivity and precision.

pmc-10699827.title: The Experiences of Strategic Purchasing of Healthcare in Nine Middle-Income Countries: A Systematic Qualitative Review
pmc-10699827.creator: Joshua Sumankuuro, Frances Griffiths, Adam D Koon, Witness Mapanga, Beryl Maritim, Atiya Mosam, Jane Goudge
pmc-10699827.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Background: Efforts to move towards universal health coverage (UHC) aim to rebalance health financing in ways that increase efficiency, equity, and quality. Resource constraints require a shift from passive to strategic purchasing (SP). In this paper, we report on the experiences of SP in public sector health insurance schemes in nine middle-income countries to understand what extent SP has been established, the challenges and facilitators, and how it is helping countries achieve their UHC goals.

pmc-11509761.title: Proteomic Analysis and Biochemical Characterization of the Nematocyst Extract of the Hydrozoan Velella velella
pmc-11509761.creator: Eleonora Tassara, Ivan Mikšík, Petr Pompach, Gian Luigi Mariottini, Liang Xiao, Marco Giovine, Marina Pozzolini
pmc-11509761.description: The venom contained within cnidarian nematocysts has a complex composition and holds significant potential for biotechnological applications. In this context, one of the most effective methods for studying nematocyst contents is the proteomic approach, which can detect even trace amounts of compounds while minimizing the need for large-scale animal collection, thus helping to preserve ecosystem integrity.

pmc-12625941.description: AbstractObjectivesThis study examined factors associated with the use of Indonesia’s National Health Insurance (NHI) among its beneficiaries in Maluku province.DesignCross-sectional study.SettingThe individual-level data were derived from the 2021 Social Health Insurance Sample Data. National health reports of Indonesia were used to provide the district-level variables.

pmc-12654967.title: Antidiabetic Properties of the Tropical Tree Schinus molle L. (pirul): A Comprehensive Review
pmc-12654967.creator: Rosa María Fonseca, Maira Huerta-Reyes, Agnieszka Sliwinska
pmc-12654967.description: The need for new medications to treat diabetes mellitus (DM) is a global health concern due to the cost and impact on patients and their families, health systems, and society. Recent approaches in drug development have focused on multitarget therapy for DM, considering its multifactorial and complex pathophysiology.

pmc-13114071.title: Distinct Molecular Responses to Ketamine and Imipramine in Cortical and Striatal Regions Following Acute Swim Stress
pmc-13114071.creator: Veronica Begni, Floriana De Cillis, Natascha Pfeiffer, Steven Roger Talbot, Peter Gass, Annamaria Cattaneo, Marco Andrea Riva, Anne Stephanie Mallien
pmc-13114071.description: Pharmacological antidepressant treatments alter the molecular and functional reactivity of stress-sensitive neural networks. However, how classical versus rapid-acting antidepressants differentially modulate acute stress-induced transcriptional responses across brain regions remains unclear. Here, we compared imipramine and ketamine in mice exposed to acute swim stress, assessing transcriptional adaptations across the frontal cortex, hippocampus, and striatum.

pmc-13357708.title: Quality differentiation and salidroside biosynthesis in Rhodiola crenulata, R. fastigiata, and intergrades
pmc-13357708.creator: Chuanxin Mo, Qiuling Wang, Binfan Si, Mingyue Yan, Cunhua Zeng, Youjun Lu, Dongsheng Ren, Wenshuai Chen, Zhen Ni, Hua Chen, Binjie Xu, Ma Yu, Jianhe Wei
pmc-13357708.description: Rhodiola crenulata, the only authentic medicinal species recorded in the Chinese Pharmacopoeia, is increasingly threatened by resource depletion and adulteration, raising concerns regarding its quality and safety. Here, an integrative multi-analysis combining phenotypic traits, anatomical characteristics, metabolite profiling, and transcriptome sequencing was conducted to systematically compare R. crenulata, R. fastigiata, and naturally occurring intergrades.
